note: Literature confirms microcephaly is reported in roughly one-third of LRRC7 cases and hypotonia is a recurring feature across LRRC7-related disorder cases.

evidence.text: In a study describing an LRRC7 neurodevelopmental disorder proband with mild microcephaly and hypotonia, the authors note that microcephaly is present in roughly one-third of reported cases and seizures in about 18% of the cohort.

source.title: Further Evidence for LRRC7 Gene Involvement in Neurodevelopmental Disorder: A Novel Variant
source.quote: Microcephaly, present in roughly one- third of reported cases, and seizures—observed in about 18% of the cohort… the mutational and phenotypic spectrum of LRRC7- related disorders
